name: memU
summary: Agent-driven personal memory stored as a shared LLM wiki across sessions, agents and devices; distills reusable skills from Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and OpenClaw history.
description: Memorizes useful session knowledge via a scheduled background task and retrieves it in future tasks, with tested host adapters for ChatGPT (work mode/Codex), Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, WorkBuddy and others on macOS, Windows and Linux (see the README matrix for limitations). Backends: memU Cloud (sign in at memu.so; the README advertises it as free and unlimited) or local/self-hosted (`pip install memu-cli`). Setup is one message to your agent pointing it at https://memu.so/SKILL.md.

agent_access.notes: Cloud mode needs a memU API key from memu.so; local mode needs none. Agent setup instructions: https://memu.so/SKILL.md
